column1: # C10 no FLUX: a interrogacao sai do modelo, nao do codigo.
# Excecao consciente a regra "prompt nunca pede texto": aqui o sinal E o assunto da cartela,
# e "?" nao e palavra. Negativo proibe qualquer letra ou palavra; se aparecer texto legivel, descarta.

column7: Comic book line art illustration, black ink contours, flat colour, cel shading. Night interior seen at a low angle: a thick CLOSED spiral notebook lies flat on a dark wooden desk, front cover plain kraft cardboard, black wire coil along its left edge, closed pages visible as thickness at the bottom. A pencil lies on the desk beside the notebook. On the cover, ONE large question mark, hand-drawn in pencil, bold, clear and slightly tilted, drawn by the same hand that owns the notebook. Behind it, an old arcade cabinet still glows cold blue in the dark, its screen bright and empty, and a warm desk lamp stands at the right. Deep shadow in the lower left corner of the frame.
